title: The Veteran's Pension Scrip
logline: An aging auxiliary pilot faces eviction from her retirement habitat when the station board retroactively reclassifies her wartime service vouchers as expired scrip.

roles.description: Retired auxiliary transport pilot; arthritic, stubborn, clutching a stamped wartime pension indenture from thirty cycles ago.
Habitat lease administrator; polite, inflexible, tasked with clearing subsidized residential berths for executive suites.
The corporate housing consortium converting subsidized veteran berths into private executive housing.
A cramped pressurized hab-pod in the lower station ring where retired service crews reside.
A decommissioned orbital depot holding microfiche service rolls from the frontier conflicts.

public_situation: Notice of eviction is posted across {role:veteran_berth} as {role:station_auditor} cancels historic auxiliary military lease vouchers.
private_truth: {role:station_auditor} retroactively altered the service codes to manufacture vacancies for a high-margin corporate real estate contract.

beats.public_change: Security seals appear on maintenance elevators leading to subsidized retirement sectors in {role:veteran_berth}.

missions.reason: She hires an independent pilot to tap the administrative node and retrieve the timestamp of the rule change that invalidated her scrip.
missions.private_fact: She signed away her right to state legal representation when she accepted the discounted housing voucher thirty years ago.

beats.public_change: Bailiffs disconnect water and secondary power lines to {role:veteran_berth} to enforce the thirty-day eviction window.

missions.reason: Purchase certified microfiche rolls of original enlistment covenants from the archive dock before historical records are recycled.
missions.private_fact: Her auxiliary wing took fifty percent casualties running fuel convoys that the regular navy refused to escort.

beats.public_change: Private security forces gather outside {role:veteran_berth} to seize the quarters by force before the arbitration deadline.

missions.reason: Deliver the certified rolls through security cordons directly to the presiding station ombudsman before the eviction order executes.
missions.private_fact: The auditor offered her a private ten-thousand-credit relocation voucher on the condition that she burns the original rolls.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds certified proof of the veteran's protected military charter. The auditor and the housing syndicate await the presentation.

options.label: Table the naval archive rolls to reinstate the veteran's lifetime tenancy and halt the redevelopment
Broker a cash buyout funding the veteran's relocation to an outer garden world in exchange for relinquishing the berth
Hand the rolls to the auditor in exchange for a syndicate contractor retainer

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the archival covenant, legally halting the eviction.
resolutions.summary: The naval covenant is validated. {role:veteran_pilot} retains her berth for life, while {role:station_auditor} faces administrative sanctions.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot uncovered old naval muster rolls to stop an auditor from throwing a decorated veteran into the street.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot negotiates an equitable cash settlement funding the veteran's quiet retirement.
resolutions.summary: {role:veteran_pilot} accepts a funded departure to an outer agricultural colony. {role:habitat_syndicate} secures the berth without scandal.

resolutions.reached_by: The archive rolls are lost or surrendered to the syndicate.
resolutions.summary: The eviction executes. {role:veteran_pilot} is expelled into public shelters, and {role:habitat_syndicate} renovates the block into luxury suites.

loose_threads.detail: The revised tenant occupancy regulations cite an administrative decree signed three hours before midnight on a holiday.
Advance lease deposits for renovated upper-ring berths were collected forty days before the eviction notices were issued.
The shipping manifest for the naval archive depot lists thirty pallets of service microfiche scheduled for unlogged incinerator disposal.

radio_hooks: Habitat housing board votes to accelerate commercial redevelopment of veteran residential wings.
Auxiliary veterans mount quiet picket line outside station municipal tenancy offices.
Real estate brokerages report surging investor demand for converted upper-deck pressurized berths.

voice_direction.veteran_pilot: Gruff, dry, and raspy. Speaks in clipped operational phrases and steadfastly refuses to plead or show physical pain.
voice_direction.station_auditor: Smooth, hurried, and patronizing. Uses dense legal jargon and repeats procedural disclaimers whenever challenged.

title: The Recluse's Final Tow
logline: A solitary retired prospector living inside a condemned radiator habitat refuses mandatory evacuation, firing upon municipal tow tugs to guard a secret vacuum ecology.

roles.description: Fabled former belt surveyor; reclusive, sharp-tongued, living alone aboard a decaying orbital radiator station.
Municipal salvage coordinator; exasperated, impatient, under strict orders to tow the decaying hulk into the star.
An antique jury-rigged mining cutter fitted with heavy pulse lasers defending the habitat approach.
The system sanitation and clearance authority tasked with deorbiting hazardous space derelicts.
A sprawling, freezing radiator fin station adrift in an outer belt graveyard.
A remote orbital supply post stocking cryo-stabilized nutrient fluid and sealing compounds.

public_situation: Municipal clearance crews issue warnings around {role:radiator_hulk} after an armed prospector drives off evacuation tugs.
private_truth: {role:solitary_recluse} is protecting a rare colony of fragile vacuum-flowering lichens growing across the habitat's freezing external fins.

beats.public_change: Clearance beacons around {role:radiator_hulk} flash orange, warning traffic that the derelict has been slated for solar disposal.

missions.reason: The bailiff hires a mercenary pilot to disable the recluse's armed sentry cutter so tow crews can attach magnetic grapples.
missions.private_fact: The recluse hails mid-combat offering high-grade uncut bismuth cores if the pilot repels the salvage tugs instead.

beats.public_change: The recluse invites the pilot to dock in the freezing radiator wing, revealing blooming biological carpets spanning the vacuum panels.

missions.reason: Retrieve industrial sealant compounds from the chemical depot to plug thermal fluid leaks threatening to freeze the lichen beds.
missions.private_fact: She spent forty years cataloging these lichens and knows the thermal shock of moving the station will render them extinct.

beats.public_change: Municipal tow vessels reform in close formation with a heavy tractor tug to drag the station away by force.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver heavy silicate slag to encase the lichen habitat wing in a protective micrometeorite and radiation berm.
missions.private_fact: The bailiff has private instructions to clear the navigational lane before a corporate freight convoy arrives tomorrow.

player_choice.prompt: The radiator wing is reinforced with silicate ballast. The bailiff hails with a final ultimatum before firing main tractor engines.

options.label: Register the lichen beds with colonial conservators to establish a permanent navigational exclusion sanctuary
Persuade the recluse to harvest seed samples and accept relocation to an orbital research conservatory
Stand aside and permit the municipal tugs to grapple the station and drag it toward the star

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot files scientific telemetry of the vacuum lichens, establishing a permanent ecological exclusion zone.
resolutions.summary: The station is declared an ecological reserve. {role:solitary_recluse} remains aboard as legal custodian, and {role:salvage_commission} reroutes shipping lanes.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended a freezing radiator station so a solitary prospector could protect her garden of void-blooming lichens.

resolutions.reached_by: The recluse agrees to harvest viable spore pods and relocate to an orbital botanical institution.
resolutions.summary: Lichen specimens are secured for cultivation. {role:solitary_recluse} is granted an orbital residency, and the derelict hull is scuttled peacefully.

resolutions.reached_by: The bailiff's tugs lock tractors and drag the station into the system primary.
resolutions.summary: Tractor tugs haul {role:radiator_hulk} into solar incinerator disposal. The unique vacuum flora is vaporized, and {role:solitary_recluse} is placed in forced municipal hospice.

loose_threads.detail: The municipal clearance contract carries an expedited bonus clause funded by an anonymous logistics cartel.
Data slates found in the chemical depot show repeated encrypted inquiries regarding vacuum lichen enzymes from an unlisted laboratory.
Scrap futures for heavy radiator alloy jumped fifteen percent the afternoon the eviction decree was posted.

radio_hooks: Salvage authorities warn civilian craft away from condemned outer belt orbital radiator arrays.
Surveyors report unusual photosynthetic bioluminescence signatures on outer station wreckage.
Clearance tugs requisition additional tractor beam capacitors for high-inertia salvage operations.

voice_direction.solitary_recluse: Sardonic, gravelly, and unhurried. Speaks with the quiet detachment of someone who has spent decades speaking only to herself.
voice_direction.clearance_bailiff: Fretful, bureaucratic, and overworked. Speaks quickly in exasperated bursts, constantly checking countdown timers.
